lines.text: Many learners say: Are you not hungry? Yes, I am not.
Better: Are you not hungry? No, I am not.
Your answer is no, so say no.

data.wrong: Are you not hungry? Yes, I am not.
data.right: Are you not hungry? No, I am not.
data.why: Your answer is no, so say no.

quiz.stem: Are you not hungry? ___, I am not.

native.tip: 한국어는 ‘안 배고파요?’에 ‘네, 안 배고파요’라고 답해서 yes가 나오기 쉬워요. 영어는 답이 부정이면 no예요. “No, I am not.”

en.tip: If your answer is negative, say no. Say “No, I am not.”
en.caption: Do you say “Are you not hungry? Yes, I am not.” in English? 😅 In English, your own answer decides: if it is negative, say no. “Are you not hungry? No, I am not.” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
